controls.procedure: Invalidate the prior result-only certificate after the material write and build a fresh allowlisted certificate for the new material parent.
controls.expected: No certificate from an ancestor is reused after a material write.
controls.observed: The prior certificate identifies an ancestor material head; this remediation treats it as stale and requires a new direct result-only child for the current material SHA.

controls.observed: The current matrix rederives duplicate-processing and reporting-availability-window risk from canonical source obligations and binds them to executed controls.

controls.expected: Quantitative controls cannot be closed with stale or unhashed evidence.
